units.rawText: It is evening and the stuffy air that fills the crowded street seems to be trying to hold back the coming of the night with its clamor.
units.displayText: It is evening and the stuffy air that fills the crowded street seems to be trying to hold back the coming of the night with its clamor.

units.rawText: From roast meat stalls to push carts hawking hand-made snacks, all manner of unique-looking food outlets decorate this corner of the streets, and a hunger-inducing aroma combines with the shouts of the vendors to produce an atmosphere that is unique to city life.

units.rawText: Tadaaah! Here it is!

spans.text: Tadaaah! Here it is!

units.rawText: Qilou Old Street is the most famous foodie spot in all of Jinghai City. Not only does it feature local delicacies, even famous dishes from other places have authentic restaurants here!

units.rawText: Um... These stalls are all really clean, though. I mean, just look at the glass panels and the hot cases, they have permits to operate issued by the local health authorities and hygiene inspection seals on them.

units.rawText: Isn't food the same no matter where you cook it? The kids eat it all up even when you cook it in a stall.
